text:
noah: Heads up — seeing a sustained spike in NVIDIA Xid 13 and Xid 31 on the us-west2 A10 pool since ~01:10 UTC. Mostly from embedder tenants (search-lite, catalog-embed).

maria: timeline? which nodes are hot?

noah: quick summary — 6X more Xid13 and 4X Xid31 compared to baseline. Skewed to node i-0a1b2c3d (rack r7b). Affected jobs look like large-batch embed requests (batch_size=512, seq_len up to 2048).

aj: can you paste a log snippet?

noah: sure — copying kernel trace + scheduler info:

```
[2026-03-17T01:12:03Z] GPU0 Xid 13: 0x00000002 - hw decode kernel panic
[2026-03-17T01:12:03Z] ECC: corrected errors on GPU0 (64 corrected)
[2026-03-17T01:12:03Z] process=embedder-v2 tenant=search-lite job_id=jn-789 batch=512 seq=1..2048
[2026-03-17T01:12:08Z] GPU0 Xid 31: 0x0000000f - illegal instruction in cuLaunchKernel
[2026-03-17T01:13:01Z] kube: pod/emb-search-lite-7 moved to node i-0a1b2c3d (affinity=prefer_same_gpu)
```

tasha: that ECC aside + Xid mix usually indicates thermal or VRAM pressure — but the corrected errors are interesting (not raw ECC fatal). Could be bursty memory scrubbing + heavy contiguous batch allocations.

aj: agree. This feels different from the nvlink PCIe flaps we've seen — those had Xid48 and massive pcie resets. Here it's kernel-level decode + illegal kernel launches. Workload pattern: big BX embedding while KV cache thrashes.

maria: any recent driver or runtime changes?

noah: no driver rollouts in us-west2 last 48h. Model patch for embedder-v2 rolled out 03/15 but identical in eu-west. Only us-west seeing this amplitude.

infra-bot: detected node i-0a1b2c3d has GPU0 corrected ECC errors rate > 50/min for last 30m. Suggest drain if > 100/min sustained.

noah: I started a quick repro by sending synthetic batches to the node (replica job emu-quick). Observed Xid13 after ~120s of sustained batches at 512. Lowering batch to 256 removes the reproducible Xid in 10/10 runs.

aj: good repro. Software mitigations we can try short-term: 1) scheduler spread to avoid packing multiple heavy embed pods on same GPU, 2) reduce default max_batch for embedder-v2 for us-west2 via config rollout, 3) enable per-tenant QOS throttles.

maria: agree. Long-term: pin noisy tenants to dedicated capacity or fixed-affinity pools. Cost tradeoff: moving search-lite to dedicated A10 reserved would add ~$3k/week but avoid live instability and reduce engineering toil.

sre-oncall: immediate ops plan:
- mark node i-0a1b2c3d as soft-drain candidate (no new pods)
- migrate heavy embed pods with priority preempt to other nodes (spread)
- run gpu-memtest + stress for 2 hours after soft-drain
- escalate to physical card replacement if corrected ECC doesn't drop

devops-bot: scheduled soft-drain of i-0a1b2c3d at 02:00 UTC (window +1h). Will attempt live migration first.

tasha: one more note — observed similar pattern months ago where a small subset of nodes had kernel launch failures under contiguous memmap. Replacement fixed it. So prepare for RMA.

noah: I'll open infra ticket: INF-5227 with logs, repro steps, and link to this thread. Assigning owners: maria -> run memtest and stress (ETA 04:00 UTC), aj -> update scheduler spread settings and lower embedder-v2 max_batch to 256 for us-west2 (ETA 01:45 UTC), tasha -> plan physical replacement / RMA if ECC persists (ETA decision 06:00 UTC).

maria: memtest command I'll run:
```
sudo ./gpu_memtest --gpu 0 --pattern contig --duration 2h --stress-kernel
```

aj: scheduler tweak — creating rollout: set podAntiAffinity for embed-heavy labels and set cluster autoscaler to prefer spreading across racks. Will monitor 30m after rollout.

noah: monitoring plan: infra dashboards updated to show Xid13/31 per GPU, per-tenant error rate, and per-batch-size distribution. Alert thresholds: Xid13 > 10/min OR corrected ECC > 30/min -> paged to oncall.

infra-bot: dashboards updated. New alert: xid13-uswest2-high firing at 01:34 UTC.

aj: quick note on why batch size matters — bigger contiguous allocations increase pressure on contiguous VRAM, GC and kernel launch paths. The runtime's fallback for OOM sometimes triggers unusual kernel paths that have historically surfaced Xid13. So reducing batch is low-friction.

maria: after reproducing, memtest found intermittent corrected ECC bursts on GPU0 only. Will let memtest finish and post results.

noah: decision for this incident: 1) immediate config change to reduce max_batch for embedder-v2 in us-west2 (done by aj), 2) soft-drain node i-0a1b2c3d and run memtest (maria), 3) if ECC corrected errors remain above threshold after stress, mark GPU for replacement and schedule cradle swap (tasha).

tasha: noted. If we RMA, target swap during maintenance window 03/18 02:00-06:00 UTC to minimize customer impact.

aj: rolled out max_batch=256 to us-west2 canaries at 01:50 UTC. Early metrics: Xid13 rate down 70% in canaries.

noah: great. tagging customers potentially impacted: @search-team (FYI) and scheduling follow-up postmortem if RMA occurs.

maria: memtest finished — GPU0 shows persistent corrected ECC bursts (spike every ~12min) despite thermal within normal. Looks like hardware degradation. Uploading artifact to INF-5227.

devops-bot: INF-5227 created and linked to this thread.

noah: OK we have consensus. I'll start the replacement flow and set node to drain at 02:00 UTC. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: follow-up: monitor for residual Xid13 in neighboring nodes after migration — if we see spreading, pause further migrations and escalate.

noah: noted. Closing active remediation loop; will post final status after replace.
